This is a list of themes that have been played in the {{pmin|Iceland|Icelandic}} dub of the {{pkmn|animated series}} and {{pkmn|movie}}s.. ==Openings== Only the first season and the first five movies were dubbed into Icelandic. [[Pokémon Theme]] in [[M01]] and {{so|Pokémon World}} in [[M02]] were left in English, as well as the ending songs in these movies. ===[[Pokémon Theme]]=== [[File:OPE01.png|250px|thumb|Indigo League]] This opening was sung by Vilhjálmur Goði Friðriksson, with backing vocals of Pétur Örn Gudmundsson. {{Schemetable|Kanto}} !
